scope_guards: SSSI Impact Risk Zones are rapid initial screening and consultation tools, not SSSI boundaries or automatic refusal zones.
The current IRZ dataset, proposal type and consultation threshold must be matched to the exact development.
The Designated Sites record and ORNEC list must be checked for the relevant SSSI and operation.
Landowner or occupier consent and public-body assent are distinct statutory routes.
Planning permission, environmental permits and protected-species licences do not automatically replace SSSI consent or assent.
SSSI condition assessments are feature and unit evidence and not exact candidate ecological surveys.
Where an SSSI also supports a habitats site, Habitats Regulations Assessment duties remain separate.
No score or promotion is written without exact SSSI, IRZ trigger, notified features, operation, consent or assent, condition and planning evidence.
